$description: AUTHORED — traits: stackable partial looks resolved per-axis against a runtime Tone. Generated to traits_gen.rs; hue/step refs are cross-validated at build (unknown → build fails). Composition (docs/design/doctrine.md): additive axes (shadows, back_glow, tints, anim) concatenate across the stack; override axes (fill, edge, radius, ink, font) last-wins. A hover/active block overlays that trait's axes for the state. Color refs: {tone:STEP} = the surface Tone's ladder at STEP; {hue:ID,step:STEP} = a fixed pool hue; {surface:SLOT} / {ink:SLOT} = a named slot; {black:true}; optional alpha (0-255, default 255). role: base = neubrutalist/claymorphic (one per surface); stack = cyber/retro (ride on top). NOTE: cyber/retro animation (hue-drift/crt-flicker) is deferred until motion.json carries the effects + a cheap painter — anim is empty for now.

traits.label: Neubrutalist
traits.blurb: Flat saturated surface, crisp hard edge, hard offset shadow, lit-from-behind glow. Loud, honest, tappable — and cheap.

traits.label: Claymorphic
traits.blurb: Soft extruded plane — directional light top-left, shadow bottom-right, generous radius. Content sits in it; it is never a button.

traits.label: Cyber
traits.blurb: Cyan neon — a glow bloom, a top wash, a bright thin edge. Rides on top of a base.

traits.label: Retro
traits.blurb: CRT amber — sharp corners, a chunky amber edge, a scanline wash. Rides on top of a base.
